title: client.transcript.client.partial
description: Interim client-recognised text of an utterance still being spoken (client STT mode, ADR-0008); a later partial or the final with the same segment_id replaces it.

segment_id.description: Client-assigned; the partials and the final of one utterance share it.

client_start_ms.description: Client clock, Unix epoch ms, when the utterance started.

client_end_ms.description: Client clock, Unix epoch ms, at the end of the recognised text; never before client_start_ms.

provider.description: Id of the client recognizer that produced the text, e.g. web-speech.

language.description: BCP 47 tag as the recognizer reports it, e.g. es-ES.

confidence.description: The recognizer's own score, when it reports one.
